HYPE.thesis: Strong value capture, but first recorded discovery occurred near an all-time high after a large repricing.
HYPE.invalidation: Value capture weakens materially or crowding/supply overwhelms demand.

UNI.thesis: Protocol value-capture thesis is real, but first recorded Hunter discovery followed a very large 30D repricing.
UNI.invalidation: Fee/burn value capture weakens or spot demand fails.

ARB.thesis: Strong repricing and volume require research, but first Hunter discovery was after a sharp multi-day move.
ARB.invalidation: Activity/revenue thesis fails or supply pressure dominates.

NEAR.thesis: Strong market move merits post-move research, but slow non-price confirmation is incomplete.
NEAR.invalidation: Relative strength/spot demand fades without corroborating non-price evidence.

ASTER.thesis: 99% of daily platform fees programmatically buy back ASTER while an equal reserve amount is burned; the 400M team allocation cliff was extended by 12 months to Sep 2027, reducing near-term dilution before a large price repricing.
ASTER.invalidation: Fee-funded buybacks materially weaken, delayed team vesting is reversed, emissions overwhelm burns, or platform activity/revenue deteriorates materially.
ASTER.stage_correction_reason: Post-discovery evidence review: Sep tokenomics catalyst had already produced material price pulses before first Hunter discovery; current stage corrected prospectively without rewriting immutable first-discovery event.
ASTER.first_tranche_logic: Under current ordinary portfolio asymmetric single-asset 2% hard cap, eventual max is ~798 USD; v2.16 first tranche normally <=20% => ~160 USD maximum proposal.
thesis_kill: Unlock/emissions accelerate beyond modeled near-term schedule

supply_audit.unresolved: Reconcile all remaining Airdrop/Ecosystem/Treasury/Liquidity releases through the intended holding horizon; third-party schedules conflict and one tracker contains internally inconsistent wording.
supply_audit.required_before_capital: Complete month-by-month net supply map, subtract modeled buyback/burn, then rerun current-price FRM and position sizing.

process_review.reason: Material forward supply release was not fully reconciled before sizing/proposal.

JTO.thesis: JTX creates a new fee stream where 80% of platform fees flow to the DAO and the DAO share is committed to JTO open-market buyback and burn through Q4 2027; price has not materially repriced over the last month.
JTO.invalidation: JTX fails to generate material fees/volume, buyback commitment changes, or upcoming insider/investor unlock pressure dominates value capture.
JTO.evidence_correction: JTX buyback catalyst had already repriced to ~0.63 in Jul-2026 then faded below discovery price; treat as FAILED_REPRICING evidence, not '30D no repricing'.

process_review.reason: PRE_MOVE discovery did not reach first-tranche proposal before subsequent repricing because process/SHADOW coupling blocked proposal formation.

JTO.forward_return_blocker_detail: Official Jito docs confirm 1B total supply and investor/core-contributor vesting over 3 years with 1-year cliff, while current third-party unlock trackers conflict on whether vesting is fully unlocked versus two remaining 2026 unlocks. V1 requires reconciliation before capital proposal.
JTO.next_remediation_target: Reconcile remaining investor/core-contributor vesting amount and timing from authoritative/on-chain data; then immediately complete JTO current-price FRM.

ENA.thesis: Fee-switch governance passed and early-investor supply overhang was restructured; first Hunter encounter followed ~80% 30D repricing, so discovery quality is late, but historical appreciation is not a capital hard reject under the corrected SSOT.
ENA.invalidation: USDe growth fails to approach activation thresholds, approved value capture is not implemented, supply pressure overwhelms demand, or prospective TASK5 forward-upside/risk gates fail.

process_review.live_evidence: User Bybit screenshot 2026-09-26 01:39 +07 shows ENA 0.26044, +20.84% 24h, high 0.26423.

supply_model.caveat: Foundation did not publish exact investor amount or how much of the cliff is now Foundation-owned after OTC buyouts; ecosystem release calendar remains incomplete.

forward_return_model.note: Scenario valuation, not prediction. Exact sellable Oct5 supply remains unknown.

explosive_upside_map.interpretation: Near-term/base BTC underperformance no longer rejects ENA. Capital decision depends on exact sellable Oct5 supply, ecosystem release calendar, and whether later bull/extreme value-capture path offers sufficient asymmetry.

CRO.thesis: Ult and Cronos Launch create product-revenue optionality; a public proposal would route 100% of those revenues to open-market CRO buybacks and burns, alongside a separate community-pool burn proposal.
CRO.invalidation: Revenue-buyback proposal fails/does not progress, product revenue is immaterial, or large non-circulating supply overhang dominates demand.
CRO.first_tranche_logic: <=20% eventual asset max; no execution proposal on Bybit while CRO spot unavailable
thesis_kill: Supply overhang begins entering market materially

MNT.thesis: MNT has real Bybit utility (fee discounts, VIP acceleration, Launchpad commitment) plus Mantle ecosystem/Treasury optionality, but no verified fresh revenue-based buyback/burn governance progression was found in this run.
MNT.invalidation: Bybit utility weakens, treasury supply begins material distribution, or Mantle activity/value capture deteriorates.
MNT.wait_price_context: Prefer re-evaluation near prior breakout/base region around 0.60-0.62 unless a new independent value-capture catalyst materially improves FRM.
thesis_kill: No improvement in token value capture

AERO.thesis: Aerodrome has real exchange revenue distributed to veAERO token operators, no VC/token sale launch structure, Bybit spot liquidity, and Arc expansion; however AERO has ongoing weekly emissions and current price has already materially repriced.
AERO.invalidation: Holder revenue deteriorates materially, weekly emissions/net float expansion overwhelm locking/buybacks, or Aero/Arc expansion fails to add durable activity.
AERO.value_capture: 100% exchange revenue is distributed to token operators (veAERO); liquid AERO must be locked to obtain this claim. Foundation also uses part of its revenue for buybacks.

supply_forward_map.30d: Approx 0.9% gross annual-rate-equivalent issuance before locks/buybacks; no identified large VC/team cliff.
supply_forward_map.90d: Approx 2.7% gross annual-rate-equivalent issuance; third-party chain analysis estimated ~4.3% net float expansion over 90d under then-current locking behavior.
supply_forward_map.180d: Approx 5.45% gross annual-rate-equivalent issuance if official ~10.9% annualized rate persists; realized tradable-float change depends on locks/buybacks.

AERO.valuation_derivation: At ~717.6M circulating market cap and ~14.34M 30d holder revenue, simple annualized holder-revenue/mcap ratio is ~24%, but this value accrues to locked veAERO and must be discounted for ~10.9% annualized emissions, lock duration/illiquidity, incentive cyclicality and already-realized repricing.
AERO.wait_price_context: Re-evaluate around 0.60-0.64 if fundamentals/revenue remain intact, or sooner only on genuinely new independent value-capture evidence. Do not require right-side breakout.

PUMP.thesis: Pump.fun has large real protocol revenue and a live on-chain buyback-and-burn mechanism targeting ~50% of revenue; current price has returned to the previously interesting ~0.0038-0.0040 region.
PUMP.invalidation: Revenue/buyback commitment weakens materially, platform share erodes, or insider/community supply release overwhelms burn demand.
PUMP.official_value_capture_refresh: Official Pump page: ~500M annualized revenue, ~462.54M cumulative buyback/burn, 167.67B PUMP burned, ~50% revenue target; Sep24 burn ~211.8M PUMP / $832.4K.
PUMP.supply_reconciliation_refresh: Tokenomics.com shows Oct12 ~9.167B unlock; DefiLlama identifies 6.875B Team+Existing Investors and explicitly marks Community/Ecosystem schedule TBD because published monthly schedule was not followed.

INJ.thesis: INJ is fully circulating with no future unlocks; ecosystem revenue feeds monthly community buyback/burn; 2026 Supply Squeeze doubled deflation rate; September added Solana access, canonical USDC/Cosmos-dYdX role, Stockdrop and Meridian institutional-tokenization upgrade.
INJ.invalidation: Onchain revenue/activity fails to grow enough to justify valuation; post-catalyst demand fades while buyback/burn remains economically small; institutional/tokenized-asset expansion fails to translate into usage.
INJ.value_capture: Monthly Community BuyBack routes ecosystem revenue into an event where committed INJ is permanently burned; official Supply Squeeze reduced issuance and doubled deflation rate.
recent_catalysts: Sep10 canonical Injective USDC standard across Cosmos/dYdX migration
Sep17 INJ live on Solana via Sunrise with Raydium/StonkFun
Sep22 Stockdrop announced linking tokenized stocks with INJ burns
Sep24 Meridian network upgrade/hard fork for regulated tokenization and unified markets

explosive_upside_map.interpretation: Terminal values are scenario valuation anchors, not predictions. Current price already reflects a large September rerating; current buy requires more evidence that usage/revenue can scale, not just scheduled burn.

validation_state.quarantine_rule: V1 market-data score may not promote a candidate to executable BUY/ADD. Existing candidates remain research/watch evidence only.
validation_state.anti_overfit_rule: Do not tune V1 on the already-opened 2024/2025 OOS windows and relabel it validated.
validation_state.v2_objective: Prospective BTC-relative remaining-upside discovery using causal non-price evidence plus valuation/dilution/liquidity/risk; prior price appreciation is a risk/valuation input, not an automatic rejection.
validation_state.v2_validation: Forward-only shadow observations; no capital authority until independent evidence demonstrates positive BTC-relative incremental value.
